advice-d3935e8481da84fcca2fdce8.title: Mental dissection
advice-d3935e8481da84fcca2fdce8.body: Train yourself to stop every thought at the threshold. Do not let it "finish the story" for you. If you are told that someone is speaking ill of you, the censor must register only the fact of the report, cutting away the judgment of "harm". As Marcus Aurelius taught: "add nothing of your own, and nothing is happening to you". Your task is to see the event's "bare Logos", cleansed of emotional accretions.

advice-1dfe6125128653bb0ac078fc.title: Cleansing the throne
advice-1dfe6125128653bb0ac078fc.body: Audit your beliefs for the presence of the "executioners of darkness". Ignorance, anger and sorrow are not your qualities, but occupiers who have seized your Acropolis. A conscious person recognizes them as alien emanations and expels them through the power of direct attention. Remember the precept: "the ruling principle does not trouble itself". Everything that frightens or saddens your reason is merely "murky vapors", which disperse when you return to the foundations of your rank.

advice-d208e70cbfefef4b8f82000b.title: The practice of intellectual silence
advice-d208e70cbfefef4b8f82000b.body: Create within yourself a zone beyond the reach of the "noise of the masses" and bodily movements. Your reason must learn to "withdraw into solitude" instantly, even at the epicenter of events. This is the state of a "sphere" that shines with its own light and reaches toward nothing external. In this silence, Hegemonikon (your ruling principle) restores its density, allowing you to act as a demiurge of your destiny rather than a puppet of circumstances.

advice-484b69a6c9bde531c7d00684.title: The ritual of sovereign assent
advice-484b69a6c9bde531c7d00684.body: Every judgment you make must be an act of "right action". Stop "slaving and jerking about in unsocial impulses". Establish this law within yourself: "if it is not fitting, do not do it; if it is not true, do not say it". A conscious person lives as though their mind were a "pure statue", displayed before the face of eternity. Your inner discipline is your highest theurgy.

advice-68aa2c20279ac762f7d12c39.title: Identifying the source
advice-68aa2c20279ac762f7d12c39.body: Accustom yourself to the thought that every sudden impulse disturbing your inner peace is an "alien". A conscious person does not say "I am angry", but says "anger is trying to occupy my Acropolis". As Marcus Aurelius taught, ask yourself at every impression: "whose soul do I have now - a child's? a tyrant's? a beast's?". If an impulse bears the marks of the "executioners of darkness" (envy, anger, rashness), it must immediately be recognized as a hostile intervention and denied the right to be realized.

advice-d40bf9ab2b08e4e5bb392555.title: Intellectual exposure
advice-d40bf9ab2b08e4e5bb392555.body: Apply the method of breaking an impression into its components. Do not accept a thought in its emotional wrapping. Unfold it, examining "nature in all its nakedness". Set a limit in time: how long will this impulse last, and where will it lead your lineage? A conscious person understands that "the governing reason knows what it is doing", while everything else is merely "murky vapors" seeking to divert it from the "wondrously sacred path".

advice-706f7c9116c776cd523c8b72.title: The practice of volitional sealing
advice-706f7c9116c776cd523c8b72.body: Create distance between yourself and the impression that arises. Do not let the ruling principle "judge together with the flesh". If your body feels pain or pleasure, let it "tell for itself how it suffers there", while your reason must remain in the state of a "sphere" that shines with its own light. This "solitude within oneself" lets you see a psychic attack from the outside without becoming involved in it. Your task is to keep the blood in a state of "intellectual fire", in which any demonic seeds of thought are burned away.

advice-5df0fa8eec482863542d7a37.title: The practice of affirming rank
advice-5df0fa8eec482863542d7a37.body: At moments of pressure from alien logoi, return to your first principles. Repeat to yourself: "I am a son of Earth and starry Heaven, my lineage is heavenly". This is not autosuggestion, but a theurgic act of restoring memory. One who remembers their ontological rank becomes invulnerable to the "speechless spirits" that refuse to name themselves. Power belongs to the one who has learned to distinguish their own voice from the noise of the crowd's "drunken ignorance", and even that of the gods.

advice-ea5c6c1423852faa1a65a414.title: Psychopompia · 18+
advice-ea5c6c1423852faa1a65a414.body:
[ According to the "Corpus Hermeticum", twelve "executioners of darkness" (or tormentors) dwell in a human being and, through the body's captivity, make the soul suffer by means of sensations:

1. Ignorance (agnoia).
2. Sorrow (lype).
3. Intemperance (akrasia).
4. Desire (epithymia).
5. Injustice (adikia).
6. Greed (pleonexia).
7. Deceit (apate).
8. Envy (phthonos).
9. Cunning (dolos).
10. Anger (orge).
11. Rashness (propeteia).
12. Malice (kakia).

These twelve vices metaphysically correspond to the twelve signs of the zodiacal circle and can assume different forms in order to mislead a person. Some are organized in pairs and act together, such as Rashness, which is inseparable from Anger. All these vices must be used as weapons in the external world, unquestionably. But for interaction within the circle of one's close ones and friends, they must be banished forever. ]

advice-425ad0d884a6787d9a06df09.title: Psychopompia · 18+
advice-425ad0d884a6787d9a06df09.body:
[ According to the thirteenth treatise of the "Corpus Hermeticum" ("On Rebirth"), the ten divine Powers (the Ten) are noumenal energies that enter a human being in succession, expelling the "executioners of darkness" and forming a new "body of Logos":

Knowledge of God (Gnosis) - the first Power, which instantly destroys Ignorance upon its arrival.
Joy - the second Power, which drives out Sorrow.
Self-restraint - the third Power, which defeats Intemperance.
Patience - the fourth Power, which opposes Desire.
Justice - the fifth Power, which deprives Injustice of authority.
Communion (Selflessness) - the sixth Power, which displaces Greed.
Truth - the seventh Power, with whose arrival Deceit disappears.
Goodness - the eighth Power, which reaches fullness together with the arrival of Truth.
Life - the ninth Power, which enters into the composition of the renewed being.
Light - the tenth Power, which completes the divine sequence and the process of deification.

These Ten are the "parent of the soul" and contain within themselves the One (the source of the Decad), restoring a person's connection with the primordial source. ]

advice-e12c0073749d2f5fc3106add.title: Psychopompia · 18+
advice-e12c0073749d2f5fc3106add.body: The expulsion of the twelve "executioners of darkness" is accomplished through the active installation of ten divine Powers rather than passive resistance. A conscious person understands: their reason is a field of theurgic battle, where the Twelve vices, bound to the zodiacal circle of matter, must yield their place to the Ten, which are the true "parent of the soul". According to the thirteenth treatise of the Corpus Hermeticum, this "spiritual birth" occurs when a "body of Logos", composed of higher noumenal energies, is formed within a person. The Ten do not merely correct character; they restore ontological integrity, linking the individual "I" with the Monad - the primordial source of all that exists. As the Hermetic tradition indicates, "the Ten contain the One, and the One - the Ten", creating an unbreakable shield against entropy.

advice-e580ef8931f551852a064f7f.title: Psychopompia · 18+
advice-e580ef8931f551852a064f7f.body: The theory of rebirth rests on a strict sequence of replacement. The first Power is Knowledge of God (Gnosis), which instantly annihilates Ignorance. It is followed by Joy, driving out Sorrow. Third comes Self-restraint, defeating Intemperance. The fourth Power is Patience, opposing Desire. Justice ascends to the fifth place, depriving Injustice of strength. Sixth is invoked Communion (selflessness), displacing Greed. Finally, seventh comes Truth, with whose arrival Deceit disappears and Goodness reaches fullness. Life and Light complete this divine sequence. When these Powers occupy their thrones in reason, the "executioners of darkness", in the words of Hermes Trismegistus, "fly away, vanquished, loudly beating their wings". This process turns a conscious person into a "son of the One", whose new body is composed of Powers and is not subject to the decay of the material world.

advice-62a07c3c0973596b84286c91.title: The method of dynamic replacement
advice-62a07c3c0973596b84286c91.body: Never fight a vice directly - that only feeds it with your attention. A conscious person uses the law of displacement. If you discover the presence of an "executioner" within yourself (for example, Anger or Rashness), immediately concentrate Nous on the Power of Patience. Invoke it as a real energy of your ancestral Logos rather than an abstract idea. As soon as the Power "arrives", the vice disappears of its own accord, deprived of its substrate.

advice-e6f128242d565a3daa2f5f37.title: Cultivating intellectual Joy
advice-e6f128242d565a3daa2f5f37.body: Understand that Sorrow is a miasma indicating a loss of connection with the Source. A conscious person trains Joy as an intellectual muscle. This is not an emotion, but "knowledge of Joy", based on memory of one's heavenly origin. When this Power is active, your inner Acropolis becomes unreachable for the "tormentors" seeking to impose servile grief on you.

advice-d6b9ef74d7b0a84a4c9eb7a3.title: Synchronization with the Monad
advice-d6b9ef74d7b0a84a4c9eb7a3.body: Remember that all ten Powers originate in the One. Your task is to keep the mind in a state of "sunlike" simplicity. The number Ten describes a perfect cycle: having completed purification, you return to the One, but in a new capacity. Learn to see the working of a single divine rhythm behind the diversity of life's challenges. One who has recognized themselves as a "vessel of the Powers" ceases to be a "multiple human being" and acquires the density of a god.

advice-8b5a4d7bcdf628cff36f6f35.title: The ritual of fixing the Light
advice-8b5a4d7bcdf628cff36f6f35.body: Use periods of silence to check the purity of your composition. Enter the state of the "Ogdoad" (the eighth sphere), rising above the noise of zodiacal influences. In this state you hear the "melodious voice of the Powers", singing praise to the Father. Your life must become a "verbal sacrifice", in which every action is an emanation of one of the ten Powers, strengthening the structure of your lineage in eternity.
